s.how: Grill 8 hot dog franks until they split and blister. Tuck each into a soft bun with a stripe of yellow mustard and a spoon of pickle relish. Wrap tightly in paper so the bun steams, then hand them out like the stand behind home plate.

Whisk 1 cup fine cornmeal, 1/2 cup self-raising flour, 1 tbsp sugar and 1 grated onion with 1 egg and 180ml buttermilk. Drop teaspoons into 5cm hot oil and fry for 3 minutes until golden. Drain and serve with butter or hot sauce.

m.how: Rub a 2kg pork shoulder with salt and roast covered at 150C for 5 hours until it pulls apart. Simmer 250ml apple cider vinegar with 3 tbsp brown sugar and chilli flakes and toss through the shredded pork. Pile into buns with shredded cabbage slaw.

w.note: Annie's church of baseball, deep in the South
w.how: Whisk 4 egg yolks, 120g caster sugar and 50g cornflour in a saucepan, then whisk in 750ml milk. Cook over medium heat, stirring, for 6 to 8 minutes until thick. Off the heat, stir in 20g butter and 2 tsp vanilla. Cover the surface and cool. Layer 250g vanilla wafer biscuits, 4 sliced bananas and the custard in a dish, repeating twice. Whip 300ml cream with 1 tbsp icing sugar, spread on top and chill overnight.

d.note: a warm North Carolina night at the Durham Bulls game
d.how: Steep 4 black tea bags in 1L just-boiled water for 5 minutes, remove and stir in 80g brown sugar until dissolved. Cool, then chill for 1 hour. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice. Add 45ml bourbon to each, top with 200ml of the tea and squeeze in a lemon wedge. Slap a mint sprig between your hands and drop it in. Leave out the bourbon for non-drinkers.
